summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) to update an existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with Craig-Hallum. The registrant, Neuraxis, Inc., is increasing the aggregate offering price of common stock to $11.5 million under a Sales Agreement dated August 29, 2025. The filing provides preliminary financial estimates for Q1 2026 and discloses that $10.8 million in securities have been sold under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3 over the prior 12 months. This is a routine shelf takedown and does not constitute a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring terms.
